evidence: Cic. ND 3.86: vīnēta, segetēs, olīvēta (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Cui avia: «At hīc olīva est. Ascende, sīmiole.»
phrases.english: Grandma answered, “But here there’s an olive tree. Climb up, little monkey.”

phrases.latin: eum quī aret olīvētum, rogāre frūctum; quī stercoret, exōrāre; quī caedat, cōgere
phrases.english: he who ploughs the olive grove asks it for fruit; he who manures it wins the fruit by asking; he who prunes it forces it

sources: Lewis & Short: oliva
